```{r}
#| label: home-stats
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Count posts the same way the listing pages do:
# every .qmd under the folder, skipping "_" files and the "Template" post.
read_meta <- function(f) {
  tryCatch(rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f), error = function(e) list())
}

post_meta <- function(dir) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.qmd$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[!startsWith(basename(files), "_")]
  meta  <- lapply(files, read_meta)
  keep  <- vapply(meta, function(m) !identical(m$title, "Template"), logical(1))
  meta[keep]
}

viz   <- post_meta("data_visualizations")
projs <- post_meta("projects")

years <- vapply(viz, function(m) {
  d <- as.character(if (is.null(m$date)) "" else m$date)
  if (grepl("^\\d{4}", d)) as.integer(substr(d, 1, 4)) else NA_integer_
}, integer(1))
first_year <- min(years, na.rm = TRUE)

stat <- function(num, label) {
  sprintf('<div class="home-stat"><span class="home-stat-num">%s</span><span class="home-stat-label">%s</span></div>',
          num, label)
}

cat("```{=html}\n",
    '<div class="home-stats">',
    stat(length(viz),   "visualizations"),
    stat(length(projs), "projects"),
    stat(first_year,    "publishing since"),
    "</div>\n```\n", sep = "\n")
```

### About Me

I share data visualizations built for weekly community challenges — TidyTuesday, MakeoverMonday, and SWD Challenge — along with the R code behind them, and the occasional lesson learned along the way.

By day, I'm a Senior Manager and Clinical Trial Risk Analyst in Clinical Trial Risk Management at Bristol Myers Squibb in New Jersey. Views here are my own.

<hr>

### Interests

* Data storytelling and visual communication
* R, the tidyverse, and the ggplot2 ecosystem
* Clinical trial risk analytics and signal detection
* Open data and community challenges
